issue.title: ngFor with Animations, does not display filtered items correctly
issue.body:
**I'm submitting a ...**  (check one with "x")

```
[ x ] bug report
[ ] feature request
[ ] support request 

**Current behavior**
Setup: ngFor with Animation state defined.  When filtering the array that the ngFor is based on, items are not displayed correctly.  Removing the animation state eliminates the issue.  

**Expected/desired behavior**
Items are shown by ngFor on array filter when animation is present.  

**Reproduction of the problem**
https://embed.plnkr.co/5hBpYSLIbdXCeFq742C4/

Type 'ab' in the filter textbox.
Observe that the appropriate filtered items are not displayed.  
Removing the animation state attribute from the li element eliminates the issue.

**What is the expected behavior?**
Items are shown by ngFor on array filter when animation is present.  


**What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior?**
To be able to filter  a list items that are displayed by ngFor with Animations. 

**Please tell us about your environment:**

* **Angular version:** 2.0.0-rc.3

* **Browser:** [all ] 

* **Language:** [TypeScript 1.8] 
```

issue.title: NgFor with @Animations screws up animations when updating the list
issue.body:
**I'm submitting a ...**  (check one with "x")

```
[x] bug report
[ ] feature request
[ ] support request => Please do not submit support request here, instead see https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#question
```

**Current behavior**

I have a component showing a list of items using `ngFor` and using animations using `@animate`. If I add or remove items from the end of the list, the animations work fine. But if I attempt to add or remove an item from any position that is not the end of list, the animations screw up big time.

Check out the [Plunkr](http://plnkr.co/edit/9EUPvVApMzJx9qCMHE2y?p=preview). Try clicking the buttons a few times and you'll see exactly what I mean.

**Expected/desired behavior**

When adding items to the start or middle of the list, I'd expect just that element to be animated and nothing else. I certainly don't expect all other items vanishing or flickering like you see in the Plunkr.

**Reproduction of the problem**

Check this [Plunkr](http://plnkr.co/edit/9EUPvVApMzJx9qCMHE2y?p=preview) out for a demo of the issue.

**What is the expected behavior?**

**What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior?**

I believe it is a common use case that one would want to animate list insertions and deletions.

**Please tell us about your environment:**
- **Angular version:** 2.0.0-rc.4
- **Browser:** [Chrome] 
- **Language:** [TypeScript]

body: Here is a plunk that I think exhibits another variation of this problem: https://plnkr.co/O6lV5b. Removing the last item works, but removing the first item causes the void animation to run on all of the elements and they all end up being removed.
me and @robertmesserle have been working on this problem for a few days. We're close to getting a solution in time for RC5.
